line_map.label: TABLNTH
line_map.unreached_as_instruction: TABLNTH (OCT 12) runs as TC 012 only for a -0 display word or a negative DSPCNT, which nothing stores (fresh start writes -BIT12, DSPIN complemented codes)

line_map.label: 120MRUPT
line_map.unreached_as_instruction: 120MRUPT (DEC 16372) runs as CA 7764 only when DSPSCAN finds DSRUPTEM positive; DSPOUTSB sets it to -0 and the scan only stores +0 there

line_map.label: OCT37737
line_map.unreached_as_instruction: OCT37737 runs as CA 7737 only when SYNCT4 finds DSRUPTSW +0, which adding BIT9 to a negative DSRUPTSW never yields (it reaches -0 or a positive count)

line_map.label: STORCMD
line_map.unreached_instruction: the positive branch of CCS A after MASK BIT15 and RXOR LCHAN of two MASK BIT15 values: A is +0 or 140000 (negative), never positive, so TCF CMDSETUP here is never taken
